title: CaseGraphen MCP host: memory_propose_claim / memory_propose_supersession / memory_propose_retraction / memory_propose_procedure payload
description: The literal `payload.memory_proposal` an MCP client sends for the memory proposal tools. The host refuses at runtime (invalid_payload) if `target_claim_id` is absent for memory_propose_supersession or memory_propose_retraction; it is unused by memory_propose_claim and memory_propose_procedure. memory_propose_procedure additionally refuses (memory_kind_mismatch) unless `claim.memory_kind` is "procedure". Neither per-tool requirement is expressible in this schema, since one contract serves four tools.
